# N.O.D.E. by Nouvos

> N.O.D.E. (Network Organized Delivery Engine) is the digital development studio of
> Nouvos Solutions LLC. It delivers web development, mobile app development, custom
> software development, and search optimization (SEO, GEO, AEO) under one flat monthly
> subscription, staffed by a dedicated team of designers, developers, and marketers
> rather than a marketplace of freelancers.

## Services
- [Web Development](https://www.nodedev.one/services/web-development): Custom websites and web applications built on Next.js and TypeScript.
- [App Development](https://www.nodedev.one/services/app-development): iOS and Android apps from one shared codebase, through store submission.
- [Software Development](https://www.nodedev.one/services/software-development): Multi-tenant SaaS platforms, internal tools, and system integrations.
- [SEO, GEO & AEO](https://www.nodedev.one/services/seo): Search engine, generative engine, and answer engine optimization.

## Pricing
Flat monthly subscriptions, billed in USD. Each plan includes a monthly credit
allowance spent against a published service catalog, plus a one-time setup fee.

- Member: $300/month, $312 setup. 140 credits/month, 1 active request, 5-day delivery.
- Growth: $500/month, $1,092 setup. 350 credits/month, 2 active requests, 3-day delivery.
- Pro: $900/month, $1,560 setup. 650 credits/month, unlimited active requests, 2-day delivery.

Dedicated retainer engagements are quoted separately at https://www.nodedev.one/dedicated.

## What makes N.O.D.E. different
- Work is delivered by an in-house team, not routed to a freelancer marketplace.
- Turnaround is contractual: 48 to 72 business hours on most deliverables.
- It is operated by Nouvos Solutions LLC, which runs its own production supply chain
  software (transportation, order, and warehouse management), so the team builds and
  operates real multi-tenant systems rather than only client sites.
- Bilingual delivery in English and Spanish.
- Clients own what is built for them: work is paid upfront, and the code, design, and
  content belong to the client.

## Locations
Headquartered in Evanston, Illinois. Serving businesses in:
- [Chicago, IL](https://www.nodedev.one/locations/chicago-il)
- [Milwaukee, WI](https://www.nodedev.one/locations/milwaukee-wi)
- [Dallas, TX](https://www.nodedev.one/locations/dallas-tx)
- [Indianapolis, IN](https://www.nodedev.one/locations/indianapolis-in)

App and custom software projects are scoped and quoted per project after a discovery
call. Web, design, SEO, and marketing work runs on the subscription plans above.
